data.name: ValuesNotAnObject
data.value: Enter the values as an object from each variable's name to { type, value }.

data.name: ValuesTooLarge
data.value: The remembered values go over 64 KiB.

data.name: NameInvalid
data.value: Each name is a variable name: it starts with a letter, _ or $, has up to 64 characters and is not a reserved word or a Prism name.

data.name: NameRepeated
data.value: A name appears twice in the values.

data.value: Each value is an object { type, value }, or { type: "list", items }.

data.name: ListInList
data.value: A list does not take another list inside.

data.name: ItemsNotAList
data.value: The list's items are a list of { type, value }.

data.name: TypeInvalid
data.value: The type is number, text, boolean, date, timestamp, sql, null or list.

data.name: ValueWithoutTypeAndValue
data.value: Each value is an object with type and value.

data.name: NullNotNull
data.value: The value of type null is null.

data.name: TextHalfPair
data.value: The text has half of a UTF-16 pair or invalid UTF-8.
